_comment: Hand-checked stop positions. A matching stop gets these coordinates with absolute priority over SIGA / GTFS / OSM name matching; its settlement_center warning is dropped. `name` is compared like a stop name (case, accents, punctuation ignored); `lines` (optional) limits the override to those line numbers.

overrides.name: Lombada
overrides.label: Lombada, village by Ponta do Sol (lines 4, 8, 142, 146) - OSM stop Lombada (Ponta Do Sol); the name match had picked Lombada in Funchal / São Martinho 13 km east, which put an eastbound bus into the Funchal group

overrides.name: Faial
overrides.label: Faial, village by Santana (lines 208, 53, 825) - not the Funchal quarter

overrides.name: Moinhos
overrides.label: Moinhos, Faial parish - OSM bus stop Moinhos-S Roque Faial (Moinhos in Santa Cruz / Caniço is another place, so limited to these lines)

overrides.name: Achada
overrides.label: Achada, neighbourhood between Porto da Cruz and Moinhos (OSM place; no bus stop of that name is mapped, so settlement_center)

overrides.name: S. Roque do Faial
overrides.label: São Roque do Faial village - OSM bus stop Igreja de São Roque Faial (the name match had picked the Moinhos-S Roque Faial stop 1 km away, in the Faial parish)

overrides.name: Falca
overrides.label: Falca (line 6 Funchal - Arco de São Jorge, between Boaventura and Fajã do Penedo); position supplied by the project owner, the stop had no coordinates (no SIGA / GTFS / OSM match)

funchalTerminals._comment: Which Funchal terminal a line's Funchal end uses, by operator / sub-network. Applied in build:data after the terminal-only stops are made: the first or last stop of a direction whose name starts with "Funchal" gets the group's position (name stays "Funchal"), so `npm run fetch:routes` routes OSRM from these exact nodes. Lines not listed (6xx / 181 / 502 with SIGA or GTFS positions, 500) are left alone.

groups.terminal: CAM Funchal (Rua da Ribeira de João Gomes)

walks._comment: Guaranteed walking links between the Funchal terminals (group ids). minutes = the least walking time; build:data raises it to the straight-line distance / 70 m per minute, so two terminals far apart are never closer in the planner than on foot.
